findings.description: Stripe Checkout charges one unit per line item while the in-app cart total uses each item’s cart quantity, so paid amounts diverge from the displayed cart total.
reproSteps: Start backend and frontend, open the shop at http://127.0.0.1:5173/.
Add two units of Organic Bananas ($3.49 each) and confirm the cart shows Total $6.98.
Click Checkout and read the total on the Stripe hosted checkout page, or POST /api/checkout/session with quantity 2 and GET /api/checkout/session-status for amount_total.
findings.observedBehavior: In-app total is $6.98 for two bananas, but Stripe shows $3.49 (and session-status reports amount_total 349 cents). With multiple lines, Stripe total equals the sum of unit prices once each (e.g. cart $18.96 for 2×bananas and 2×avocados becomes $9.48 on Stripe).
findings.expectedBehavior: Stripe total must equal the cart total (e.g. two bananas at $3.49 must charge $6.98 / 698 cents), with line item quantities matching the cart.

findings.description: When the cart is empty there is no Checkout control with a disabled state—the button is omitted instead.
reproSteps: Open http://127.0.0.1:5173/ with an empty cart.
Inspect the cart aside for a Checkout action.
findings.observedBehavior: With zero items the cart shows “No items yet.” and no Checkout button is rendered.
findings.expectedBehavior: Per QA criteria the Checkout control should remain present and disabled when the cart is empty.
